keyVerseDR: "...blessed are they that have not seen and have believed." (Jn 20:29)

level1.title: Thomas Believes
level1.story: Jesus came through locked doors and said, "Peace be with you!" Thomas was not there and doubted. A week later Jesus came again, and Thomas believed!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How do you know Jesus loves you?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I trust in You. Amen.

level2.title: Peace Be With You
level2.story: On Easter evening, the doors were shut for fear, and Jesus came and stood in the midst and said, "Peace be to you." He breathed on the disciples and said, "Receive ye the Holy Ghost: whose sins you shall forgive, they are forgiven them." Thomas was not with them and would not believe. Eight days later Jesus came again and said to Thomas, "Put in thy finger hither, and see My hands." Thomas answered, "My Lord, and my God."
level2.keyLine: Blessed are they that have not seen and have believed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How did Jesus help Thomas believe?
How does Jesus give us mercy today?
level2.prayer: Jesus, I trust in You. Amen.
